title: Lektra configuration
description: Schema for Lektra's config.toml, generated by scripts/gen_config_schema.py.

hover_glow.description: Enable hover effect (e.g., glow on highlight) (since 0.6.5)

comment.description: Show comment text in tooltip on hover (if comment exists) (since 0.6.5)

comment_marker.description: Show marker in the corner of the rect (if comment exists) (since 0.6.5)

comment_font_size.description: Font size for the comment tooltip (in points) (since 0.6.5)

hover_glow.description: Enable hover effect (e.g., glow on highlight) (since 0.6.5)

comment.description: Show comment text in tooltip on hover (if comment exists) (since 0.6.5)

comment_marker.description: Show marker in the corner of the rect (if comment exists) (since 0.6.5)

comment_font_size.description: Font size for the comment tooltip (in points) (since 0.6.5)

hover_glow.description: Enable hover effect (e.g., glow on highlight) (since 0.6.5)

comment.description: Show comment text in tooltip on hover (if comment exists) (since 0.6.5)

comment_font_size.description: Font size for the comment tooltip (in points) (since 0.6.5)

auto_resize.description: Apply auto fit when resizing window (since 0.5.1)

anchor_to_mouse.description: Anchor zoom to mouse position (instead of center of the view) (since 0.6.7)

font_family.description: Font family for the text (any installed font, or serif, sans-serif, monospace). Empty uses the document's own fonts (since 0.7.9)

line_spacing.description: Line spacing as a multiple of the font size (e.g. 1.4). 0 uses the document's own spacing (since 0.7.9)

reflow.description: Text style for reflowable documents (EPUB, FB2, MOBI) (since 0.7.9)

drag_threshold.description: Threshold in pixels before actually starting the selection (since 0.5.1)

search_hits.description: Show the search hits in scrollbar (since 0.5.1)

size.description: Size of the scrollbar in pixels (since 0.5.4)

hide_timeout.description: Inactive timeout after which to hide the scrollbar (since 0.5.4)

fade_duration.description: Jump marker fade duration in seconds (since 0.6.7)

enabled.description: Enable link support (both pdf links and detected URLs) (since 0.6.5)

boundary.description: Show the rect boundary for links (since 0.3.1)

detect_urls.description: Detect non-pdf link objects that are valid links (since 0.5.3)

url_regex.description: Valid regular expression that detects URLs (since 0.5.3)

hover_preview.description: Show a small preview of where an internal link goes when hovering over it, instead of the plain tooltip (since 0.7.9)

hover_preview_delay.description: Milliseconds to hover over a link before its preview shows (since 0.7.9)

hover_preview_width.description: Width of the hover preview in pixels (since 0.7.9)

hover_preview_height.description: Height of the hover preview in pixels (since 0.7.9)

highlight_matches.description: Highlight all search matches (if false, only the current match is highlighted) (since 0.6.8)

progressive.description: Progressive search (renders results progressively when enabled, which can speed up search on large documents) (since 0.6.8)

absolute_jump.description: When true, the "next" match is always the next index in the results list. When false, the "next" match is the one physically closest to the cursor. (since 0.6.9)

single_instance.description: Allow only a single instance of the application (opening a new file will open in the same instance) (since 0.7.1)

page_history.description: Page history location limit to keep track (since 0.3.0)

dont_invert_images.description: Preserve images when in invert color mode. When enabled, images in the PDF will retain their original colors even when invert mode is active. This prevents photos and diagrams from appearing inverted. (since 0.6.6)

auto_reload.description: Auto-reload file upon detecting file change (since 0.3.0)

cache_password.description: Cache the password for password-protected files so that auto-reload can re-authenticate without prompting. Disable if you prefer the password not to persist in memory beyond initial unlock. (since 0.7.4)

num_recent_files.description: Max number of recent files to keep track (since 0.3.0)

cache_pages.description: Number of pages to cache page (since 0.5.3)

mupdf_store_size.description: Maximum size of MuPDF's internal store in megabytes. The store holds decoded embedded images, fonts, and glyph bitmaps. Reduce this if memory usage is too high; increase if you notice slow re-renders after scrolling through image-heavy documents. (since 0.8.0)

auto_scroll.description: Auto scroll when selecting text that is out of view (since 0.7.1)

close_on_last_tab.description: Quit LEKTRA when the last open tab is closed. When false (the default), an empty window remains — the startup widget may be shown if that path is taken. `confirm_on_quit` still applies. (since 0.7.8)

high_contrast.description: High-contrast tone stretch applied after tint / invert. Pixels darker than black_point become pure black, lighter than white_point become pure white, midtones stretched linearly. On scanned or grayish pages this cleans up the paper background and sharpens text; on already-black-on-white PDFs it is a near no-op. Toggle at runtime with :toggle_high_contrast. (since 0.7.8)

high_contrast_black_point.description: Pixel value (0-255) below which high-contrast pushes to pure black. (since 0.7.8)

high_contrast_white_point.description: Pixel value (0-255) above which high-contrast pushes to pure white. (since 0.7.8)

color_dialog_colors.description: Colours offered in the colour dialog.

misc.description: Misc options struct (for options that don't fit in other (since 0.7.0)

respect_parent.description: Respect parent's destruction (if parent closes, close the portal too) (since 0.6.4)

dim_inactive.description: Dim inactive for portal views too (since 0.6.5)

split.description: Split direction for the portal view ("vertical", "horizontal", or "smart" — picks vertical when the view is wider than tall, horizontal otherwise) (since 0.7.4)

border_radius.description: Border radius of the preview window in pixels (since 0.6.6)

close_on_click_outside.description: Close the preview window when clicking outside of it (since 0.6.6)

width.description: Width as a fraction of the main window (default 0.6).

height.description: Height as a fraction of the main window (default 0.7).

size_ratio.description: Size of the preview window as a ratio of the main window.

opacity.description: Opacity of the preview window (0.0 to 1.0) (since 0.6.6)

show_page_numbers.description: Show page number below page thumbnail (since 0.6.9)

panel_width.description: Relative width of the thumbnail panel (compared to the main view) (since 0.6.9)

font_size.description: Font size (in points) for page number labels in the thumbnail panel (since 0.7.4)

highlight_current_page.description: Highlight the thumbnail of the currently visible page with a border (since 0.7.4)

sync_scroll.description: Automatically scroll the thumbnail panel to keep the currently visible page's thumbnail in view as pages change (since 0.7.8)

auto_hide.description: Auto hide tabs when tab count equals 1 (since 0.3.0)

close_button_mode.description: When to show the tab close (x) button (since 0.3.0)

elide_mode.description: Text elide mode when text can't fit in the tab fully (since 0.3.0)

location.description: Location of the tabs in the window (since 0.3.0)

open_position.description: Where a newly opened tab is placed in the tab bar (since 0.7.8)

show_menu_icons.description: Show standard-style icons next to menu items in the menubar. Turn off for a text-only menu; icons are set on every action regardless so this flag toggles their visibility at runtime. (since 0.7.8)

title_format.description: Title format for the window title (since 0.3.0)

padding.description: Statusbar padding in pixels: [left, top, right, bottom].

show.description: Show interaction mode in the statusbar (since 0.7.0)

icon.description: Show interaction mode as an icon (since 0.7.0)

show.description: Show session name in the statusbar (if in session) (since 0.7.0)

session.description: Statusbar component options struct. These are individual component in the statusbar that can be toggled on/off independently of the entire statusbar visibility. (since 0.7.0)

components.description: Statusbar component options struct. These are individual component in the statusbar that can be toggled on/off independently of the entire statusbar visibility. (since 0.7.0)

width.description: Width of picker in pixels (if greater than 1) or relative to the window width (0.0 - 1.0, if float) (since 0.6.9)

height.description: Height of picker in pixels (if greater than 1) or relative to the window height (0.0 - 1.0, if float) (since 0.6.9)

alternating_row_color.description: Enable alternating row colors in the picker list (since 0.6.8)

keys.description: Key bindings inside pickers (a key, or a list of keys).

blur_radius.description: Blur radius of shadow in pixels (since 0.6.0)

vscrollbar.description: Show the vertical scrollbar in the picker (since 0.5.4)

prompt.description: prompt text for the command palette (since 0.7.1)

sort_by_frequency.description: Sort commands by how often you've picked them from the command palette (most-used first), smex-style. Usage counts persist across sessions when persist_frequency is on. (since 0.7.8)

persist_frequency.description: Persist command-palette usage counts to disk (command_usage.json in the app data directory) so sort_by_frequency ranking survives across restarts. When off, usage is still tracked in-memory for the current session (so sort_by_frequency still works within one run) but nothing is loaded or saved to disk, and any previously saved history file is left untouched. (since 0.7.8)

width.description: Width of picker in pixels (if greater than 1) or relative to the window width (0.0 - 1.0, if float) (since 0.6.9)

height.description: Height of picker in pixels (if greater than 1) or relative to the window height (0.0 - 1.0, if float) (since 0.6.9)

alternating_row_color.description: Enable alternating row colors in the picker list (since 0.6.8)

blur_radius.description: Blur radius of shadow in pixels (since 0.6.0)

size.description: Size of the link hint rects (since 0.3.0)

flat_menu.description: if true, show the outline in a flat menu instead of a hierarchical one (since 0.6.9)

show_at_startup.description: Show the LLM view when Lektra starts (since 0.7.9)

auto_run.description: Run the Lua script the assistant writes as soon as its reply is complete, instead of waiting for you to press Run. The script gets the same access to Lektra as your init.lua, in a restricted environment (no io, os.execute, require, load or ffi) (since 0.7.9)

tools.description: Let the assistant act through tools (run_command, run_lua and lookup_api) and look up the Lua API only when it needs it, which keeps every request small. Turn this off for models that do not support tool calling (many local models): the whole Lua API is then sent with every request and the assistant replies with Lua code blocks that you run with the Run button (since 0.7.9)

save_history.description: Save LLM chats to disk so earlier conversations can be reopened from the History menu of the panel. Chats are stored as plain JSON files in Lektra's data folder (llm_chats) (since 0.7.9)

separate_window.description: Show the LLM view in a separate window (since 0.7.8)

dock_area.description: Location of the LLM view when not in a separate window (since 0.7.8)

model.description: Model to use for LLM view (since 0.7.8)

api_key.description: API key for the LLM model (empty for local models) (since 0.7.8)

api_url.description: API URL for the LLM model (since 0.7.8)

extra_body.description: Extra fields merged into every request body sent to the LLM endpoint.

oneOf.description: Device pixel ratio per screen name.

dpr.description: Device pixel ratio: one number for every screen, or a table keyed by screen name.

focus_follows_mouse.description: Focus of split follows the mouse (since 0.6.2)

dim_inactive.description: Dims splits that are not currently focused (since 0.6.2)

dim_inactive_opacity.description: Set the inactive split dim opacity [0-1] (since 0.6.2)

focus_border.description: Show a border around the focused split (since 0.6.3)

focus_border_width.description: Width of the focus border in pixels (since 0.6.3)

maximize_indicator.description: Show a badge in the corner of a maximized split (since 0.6.3)

keybindings.description: Key bindings: command name = key (or list of keys). Command names are listed by `lektra --list-commands`.

load_defaults.description: Load the built-in key bindings first. Set to false to start from an empty set.

filetype.description: Per-file-type overrides of the view settings, e.g. [filetype.epub.layout] or dotted keys under [filetype.pdf]. The type is lower-case (pdf, epub, djvu, ...).
